verdict.rationale: Salesforce heavily markets Agentforce agents embedded in Sales Cloud that can autonomously handle tasks like prospecting and pipeline work, and provides tooling (sf agent create, Agent Script Recipes, MCP server) for building/delegating to agents. However, all evidence is vendor marketing/docs with no independent/community confirmation of a built-in assistant users can directly delegate tasks to within the core product UI, so delivery is plausible but unverified in practice.
